blockers.detail: Repository has batch audit and dry-run commands but no batch apply/rollback implementation. Manual SQL apply is prohibited because it would bypass manifest hash, before/after snapshot and rollback gates.
Current batch dry-run builds options.size from null net fields for COUNT_ONLY rows, producing nullnull. Dry-run must be corrected and TEA-BATCH-03 must be rerun before production apply.
Current chat execution environment has no mounted Bếp Sỉ SSH key or SSH client. Production was not accessed.

requiredBeforeApply: Implement and test catalog:remap:batch:apply and rollback.
Fix COUNT_ONLY option generation so size is omitted instead of nullnull.
Rerun TEA-BATCH-03 dry-run and obtain 27/27 PASS with corrected after-state.
Create a database backup before migrations.
Run migrations and apply only through the guarded Bếp Sỉ production runner.
